items.q: Which tissue carries water and dissolved minerals from the roots to the leaves?
items.qAf: Watter weefsel vervoer water en opgeloste minerale vanaf die wortels na die blare?
items.explain: Xylem carries water and minerals upwards from the roots.
items.explainAf: Xileem vervoer water en minerale opwaarts vanaf die wortels.

items.q: Which tissue carries sugar made in the leaves to the rest of the plant?
items.qAf: Watter weefsel vervoer suiker wat in die blare gemaak word na die res van die plant?
items.explain: Phloem moves sugars from where they are made (sources, such as leaves) to where they are needed (sinks, such as roots and fruit).
items.explainAf: Floëem beweeg suikers van waar hulle gemaak word (bronne, soos blare) na waar hulle nodig is (opvangplekke, soos wortels en vrugte).

items.q: A ring of bark is removed from a tree trunk. Which tissue is removed, cutting sugar supply to the roots?
items.qAf: ’n Ring bas word van ’n boomstam verwyder. Watter weefsel word verwyder, wat die suikeraanvoer na die wortels afsny?
items.explain: Phloem lies in the bark, so removing it stops sugar reaching the roots.
items.explainAf: Floëem lê in die bas, dus stop die verwydering suiker om die wortels te bereik.

items.q: Transpiration mainly takes place through the:
items.qAf: Transpirasie vind hoofsaaklik plaas deur die:
items.explain: Most water vapour leaves the plant through the stomata in the leaves.
items.explainAf: Die meeste waterdamp verlaat die plant deur die huidmondjies in die blare.

items.q: What mainly pulls water up through the xylem?
items.qAf: Wat trek water hoofsaaklik op deur die xileem?
items.explain: Water evaporating from the leaves creates a pull that draws a continuous column of water upwards.
items.explainAf: Water wat uit die blare verdamp, skep ’n trek wat ’n aaneenlopende kolom water opwaarts trek.

items.q: On a hot, dry, windy day, transpiration increases. Why?
items.qAf: Op ’n warm, droë, winderige dag neem transpirasie toe. Hoekom?
options: The water vapour gradient between leaf and air increases
optionsAf: Die waterdampgradiënt tussen blaar en lug neem toe
Die wortels hou op om water op te neem
items.explain: Dry, moving air takes water vapour away faster, increasing the gradient and the rate of transpiration.
items.explainAf: Droë, bewegende lug neem waterdamp vinniger weg, wat die gradiënt en die transpirasiespoed verhoog.
